'''Cam Solusar Player's Preconstruct 13: ISB Crackdown''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cam Solusar]]
* '''Published:''' 10 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 ISB Solusar DS 2003 PlayersP.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

9 Imps, 5 Droids, a crime lord, some freighter pilots and one MEAN Jawa. Watch out, rebel scum.

The published list has 65 cards.

== Strategy ==

The strategy for ISB is pretty basic. Overwhelm with the agents, retrieve, drain, battle if necessary.

NOTES: I took out Admiral Piett and replaced him with Carida, since we had no systems other than Coruscant. I also decided that we should use the Mobilization Points Combo instead of Inconsequential Losses. I put IL in the main deck in place of one Probe Droid Laser Cannon. (Thanks for the catch, Rickey24) :) If anyone notices anything else, just post it in your review or on the original thread in the discussion forums. MTFBWY. :)
